historyEmpty: This agent has no history yet
allowAllActionsHint: Skips all action confirmations for Codex / Claude / Opencode (full permissions)
useProxyHint: Runs cicy_proxy_on before launch and checks the mihomo IN-USER rule
proxyPasswordDesc: Empty → prefer api_token; otherwise fall back to user==pass
mihomoRuleDesc: Optional. The full rule that must exist, e.g. IN-USER,w-1001,proxy-a
proxyTargetDesc: Pick a proxy-group or proxy node. Empty falls back to the global prefix rule.

proxyManagerAskAgent: Ask agent to add a node
proxyManagerConfigWarn: Don't edit this config file by hand — let an agent configure it for you (use the button above).
proxyManagerResetConfirm: The current mihomo.yaml will be backed up, then overwritten with the default template. All current nodes / groups / rules will be lost (restorable from the backup).
proxyManagerAskAgentHint: (password will use a placeholder you fill in yourself)

frpServerManagerSubtitle: Manage the frps background process — start / stop / restart / reload.
frpServerManagerNoClients: No clients connected (or dashboard not configured)
frpServerManagerInstallHintPowershell: Paste into PowerShell on Windows. The script self-elevates (UAC prompt) and installs frpc as a Windows service that auto-starts on boot.
frpServerManagerInstallHintBash: Paste into a terminal on macOS / Linux / WSL. frpc registers as a launchd / systemd service and connects back here automatically. Re-running with no args reuses the existing config and hot-reloads.
modelDefaultDesc: Used both as the agent's startup default model and as the gateway's default model. Empty falls back to the current provider's default.
modelDefaultPlaceholder: Empty falls back to the current agent default
gatewayOverrideDesc: Pick the provider and model the local gateway uses; defaults are filled in when you enable the gateway and can be changed anytime.
customOverrideDesc: When off, fully follow the current agent's default provider
customOverrideOnDesc: When on, override the current default model and provider
providerFieldDesc: Available providers filtered by the current agent's protocol
telegramToggleDesc: Send notifications via a Telegram bot
telegramTokenDesc: On save we check whether this token is already bound to another agent
telegramChatIdDesc: Once the token is configured, send one message to the bot and chat_id is captured automatically.
telegramChatIdPlaceholder: Waiting for the bot's first message to bind automatically
toastTokenAlreadyBound: This token is already bound. Please use a different token.
toastModelSettingsSaveFailed: Error: failed to save {{paneId}} model settings
generalIdentityDesc: How this pane shows up in the workspace and which agent runs in it.
generalBehaviorDesc: Lifecycle and permissions applied at startup.
generalProxyDesc: Local proxy used by this pane on launch.
customGatewayHint: Route this agent through the local AI gateway with selectable providers/models
networkProxyDesc: Which egress node this agent's HTTP(S) traffic uses — unrelated to the local gateway below
networkProxyDeprecatedHint: Deprecated: global mihomo already handles egress for all agents; per-agent proxy is rarely needed and may be removed in a future version.
networkProxyReveal: Network egress proxy (advanced · deprecated; defaults to global mihomo)
opencodeProtocolNote: For opencode, switching to a provider with a different protocol (Anthropic↔OpenAI) requires restarting the agent
modelRestartHintGateway: Toggling the local gateway only takes effect after restarting the agent
modelRestartHintLive: Changes to the gateway's model and provider apply live — no restart needed
caNudgeInstalled: Certificate installed — codex traffic can be audited through MITM.
caNudgeMissing: MITM certificate not detected. codex / kiro-cli are Rust and need the OS to trust this certificate when running non-gateway, or their TLS will fail. Run this on that machine's command line:
caNudgeMacNote: macOS: a system authorization dialog will appear — click "Always Trust" and enter your password (one time only).
webClientsEmptyHint: Open cicy-desktop or a browser tab to connect
webClientsTestPrompt: 请用 agent-webpage skill 测试下 clientId: {{clientId}}
anTurnScope: Scope: the latest turn (all requests from one user message)
anNodesHint: resident every request · can be trimmed
anNodeCompactHint: /compact freezes context into history (summary + frozen snapshot) and ships it every request; only /clear truly removes it
anNodeClaudeMdHint: Project instructions are resident every request; trimming CLAUDE.md lowers per-request cost
anNodeSkillsHint: The skills catalog is always resident; disable unused skills or use a lean version
anNodeMcpHint: MCP tool schemas are resident in tools; disable unused MCP servers to save
anNodeAbsentSkills: No skills catalog detected (not injected this request)
anSavingsHint: Estimated from adopting the highest-value tip below — see each item for details
anSavingsLowConf: Short observation window — projected conservatively as one active day; accuracy improves with sustained use
anDiagLegend: Each row = one recent request. Higher cache hit = lower cost; the right column says whether it hit and, if not, why.
anDiagReasonExpired: Gap over 5 min — cache expired and was rebuilt
anDiagReasonMissSystem: System prompt changed — prefix cache invalidated
anDiagReasonMissFirst: History head was rewritten — cache invalidated
anDiagReasonMissOther: Prefix unchanged but hit is low (provider caching may be off)
anPriceUnknown: No built-in price for this model; using a generic estimate
anRawUsageHint: The cache/input numbers above are taken verbatim from here, no estimation
useMitmHint: Route official-login traffic through the local MITM proxy for auditing (records requests/responses). When off, this agent goes direct via the global proxy and is not audited; takes effect after restarting the agent.
